Okay, what's the temperature at home? Should I take some medicine? I had gone home up to 102. I had taken Combiflam from the medical store twice. Okay. Right now your temperature is 101.4. Pulse is 98 and BP is 118/76, normal. Is there vomiting, diarrhea, or cough? I don't have a cough, but I feel a little nauseous. I don't feel hungry. Are you allergic to any medicine? No doctor, nothing ever happened. Just give me some antibiotic. The azithromycin one. I will get well soon. No, this looks like a viral fever, there is no benefit of antibiotics in this. We will not give azithromycin. And stop Combiflam now, if there is a suspicion of dengue, then it is not safe. Okay, then what do you want to take?
